Check reads the memory directory and reports, changing nothing: files whose
frontmatter or source lines don't parse, exact duplicates and near ones
(Dice similarity of 0.8 or more on the words of entries 5 words or longer;
titles and source lines aside), [[links]] naming no memory, MEMORY.md lines
naming no file, and files MEMORY.md doesn't name. The report is sorted, so
the same directory always gives the same one.

Usage:
  agent dream memory check [flags]

Examples:
  agent dream memory check
  agent dream memory check --dir ~/.claude/projects/-srv-app/memory --json

Flags:
      --dir string   The memory directory (default: this project's)
  -h, --help         help for check
      --json         Print as JSON

Global Flags:
      --backend string          Backend for spawn or adopt: claude, aider, agy, or shell (spawn requires it or --backend-config; adopt auto-detects)
      --backend-config string   JSON file defining a custom backend (or app settings); pass it again to status/wait/watch for agents spawned with it
  -q, --quiet                   Don't print hints (results and errors still print)
      --termd-ns string         g3d-termd namespace (default: agents; never default or wall)
